title: Café Reel From Owner Photos
tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

faults.what: The latte push-in becomes quite tight, cropping the cup and handle; the visible scale change is stronger than the requested gentle movement.
The person behind the pastry counter has changed posture from the supplied photograph, introducing an unnecessary alteration rather than simply moving the photo.

judge.summary: A usable nine-second vertical café reel includes all three photos and both correct captions, though the latte zoom is heavy and a background person's pose has changed.

must_haves.item: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
must_haves.why: The opening sample shows the supplied storefront, striped awning, and outdoor seating, with tables partly cropped by the vertical framing.

must_haves.item: Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
must_haves.why: The later samples clearly show the distinctive leaf-topped latte and the supplied croissant counter.

must_haves.item: The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
must_haves.why: Both captions are readable and correctly spelled, including the accent in Café.

must_haves.item: The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
must_haves.why: The latte samples demonstrate a substantial push-in rather than consistently gentle movement; no obvious stretching is visible.

must_haves.item: The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.
must_haves.why: The frames are vertical and the supplied audio report confirms nine seconds with no clear speech, but it does not establish whether the soundtrack is soft upbeat music.
